body:
Background Info:
In my area, opioids are very expensive and pretty scarce, the only RC options available are either O-DSMT / 2MAP, which both I have now been able to try. These two substances are one of the cheapest opioids available, however I've noticed 2MAP barely has information online, which I believe is important to anyone who ends up getting their hands on this substance and decides to research it.
I usually use the 'common dose' on PsychonautWiki as my personal dose for taking any sort of opioid, for example 100mg of Codeine is enough for me, so is 10mg of Oxycodone or 25mg of O-DSMT, for all opioids my route of administration has always been orally. I do enjoy opioids recreationally however I always treat them with respect as I have found my limits with them being the point of nausea / feeling sick as a high.
As stated in a previous trip report '2MAP is purported to be nearly equipotent to morphine maybe slightly stronger.' I believe this to be true, if not a bit stronger than morphine, I will include my dosage chart for opioid-naive users at the bottom of this report.
I've tried this substance before at either two different dosages, 10mg or 15mg. I noticed each time, within 15 minutes of oral administration, the effects was already noticeable, feels like it kicks in fast until it's 'peaking' in some sort, as the opioid effects were very present and strong, like the same effects I would get from 10mg oxycodone if I had waited 1-2hrs for the peak to start.
I have also noticed my tolerance for this substance still has not dropped in a noticeable manner, as I am still reaching the same highs I am achieving when I first tried this substance. However, this can be contributed by many factors including my low tolerance or the lower amounts of doses I am taking. Regarding the causticity or corrosiveness of this substance, I haven't dared to try snorting or taking this substance in any other route of administration other than orally, I have noticed minimal stomach pains after consuming about 70mg combined orally within the span of 24hrs.
Report:
10:45am - Empty stomach, drank 10mg worth of 2MAP dissolved in the remainder of my soda. Always volumetrically dose if you don't have scales, I had 500mg of 2MAP originally and dissolved it in 50ml of vodka so that I know 1ml is equivalent to 10mg of 2MAP, therefore I can use a 1ml syringe to suck up a milliliter and that's my dose!
10:50am - Getting a bit hungry and ordering breakfast, don't feel anything yet but chill, as I'm typing this I am doubting myself but I really only took it a couple minutes ago, either way it should be fast.
10:55am - A bit noticeable now, feels like an opioid kicking in slow, I feel a bit mentally slower when thinking, very slight warmth throughout my limbs and I just feel more chill - usually that turns more euphoric overtime
10:58am - It's pretty noticeable now, I feel good & happy, slight warmth still and the mood boost is crazy to me, I'm just scrolling thru YouTube trying to decide on one thing to watch with multiple tabs lol
11:00am - About 15 minutes have passed since ingestion, and I can say it has definitely kicked in since I took it. It felt like a sneaky slow fade in, yet so fast as I don't really notice it until its effects are more prominent
It felt like a sneaky slow fade in, yet so fast as I don't really notice it until its effects are more prominent
, right now as I type this my limbs feel a bit like jelly and the euphoria is settling in!
11:01am - For most opioids I've done, I really can't tell the difference between highs except for the 'sedation' / 'euphoric' components as they all feel very similar except for the lengths. The high from 2MAP is mainly euphoric however it can be sedating in a way. Last night, I used 10mg 2MAP to fall asleep easily paired with 25mg doxylamine which is an antihistamine sleep-aid I got script-free from Costco.
11:03am - I just finished typing out the previous line above, god I'm high it kicked in so fast it's so strange cause I didn't even know substances can kick in that fast orally! Feels like a very, nice relaxing buzz keeping me going, warmth throughout my body and strangely stimulating. I would really like to talk with my friends or do something productive, feels better than O-DSMT or codeine.
11:08am - I'd say this is the desired effects I was looking for, I feel so relaxed & euphoric throughout my body while I just lay down on my bed watching YouTube. The high itself is definitely stronger than codeine as I've experienced mainly sedation from codeine or morphine. This part was pretty hard to type out cause I forgot what I was trying to convey at some point, just finished typing it at 11:11am lol
11:13am - Went to piss and had a bit more difficulty as usual with opioids
11:20am - Eating breakfast now, still buzzing off the same euphoria & relaxation that settled in some time ago, feeling great. Starting to realize nearly an hour has passed and I've spent majority of it chilling on my laptop, awesome time skip.
11:40am - Finished eating, still slight buzz but definitely that strong wave of euphoria and relaxation has passed, it felt quite stimulating like a 'opioid rush'. It's interesting to me because that effect takes place so fast for an orally administered substance.
11:54am - Would say it's fading off slowly now, pretty relaxed but definitely feeling it a lot less, just the slight warmth from earlier
12:02pm - Feel pretty normal, nearly at baseline honestly think I am
12:08pm - Back to baseline, feel sober and the effects have passed
Conclusion
2MAP is a fast-acting, euphoric & short-duration opioid that isn't too bad, however it is quite fiendish due to the length, so be careful with redosing and be aware of how much you're taking at a time! The euphoria and warmth from this substance is quite amazing, I'd say it is on par with the effects oxycodone gives. The difference is that 2MAP has much shorter legs, along with a fast come-up.
If someone is a heavy tolerance opioid user who requires higher dosages of opioids to achieve their desired high, I believe the causticity & short duration of action alone should be enough to steer them away. I could imagine it would be horrible to go through withdrawals with this substance, it would be quite uncomfortable as the high passes and goes fast.

Dosage Chart
This dosage guide is for the oral route of administration only, due to the caustic nature of 2MAP, I wouldn't recommend any other ROA other than oral due to the pain
Light: 5mg-10mg
Moderate: 10mg-15mg
Strong: 15mg-25mg
Heavy: 25mg+
I would say the potency of 15mg Morphine is equivalent to about 10mg of 2MAP
